description: b3_asym/b3_sym is an alpha-free prediction of the chain assembly. Derived from B = -alpha[(Z-1)ln f_pp + ln f_pn + (N-1)ln f_nn]; alpha cancels in the ratio. Accuracy is REPORTED, not asserted. A nonzero result is an ISOSPIN-LABELLING asymmetry (f_pp and f_nn differ by the Hecke h, not by an EM coupling), not an electromagnetic one.

alpha_free_identity.note: qou-1pig reports the antisym overshoot as 2.287479x on the (3H - 3He) convention; it is linear in alpha. The quotient of the two overshoots is not, and is the content of this probe.

sources.why: defines the mirror split and the AME target; its ten candidates are re-ranked here on the internal asym/sym ratio, which it does not itself report

scope: (a) scope-limited. The chain assembly with the live per-bond factors, at the proton pin. Does NOT establish that the predicted asymmetry is electromagnetic.

assertions.name: CHANNEL_NONVACUOUS_f_pp_ne_f_nn
assertions.detail: |f_pp - f_nn| = 0.20906029879563931543 = h = 0.20906029879563931543.  If these were equal the derived b3_asym would be 0 identically and nothing below would mean anything.

assertions.name: SIGN_derived_b3_asym_is_POSITIVE_like_AME
assertions.detail: derived b3_asym = 0.87353662138 MeV; AME b3_asym = 0.38187744 MeV.  Both positive.
